page.overview:
Who is Innina Darenhold?

She was part of the White Tower secret group to Cairhien led by Coiren Saeldain and took part in kidnapping Rand al'Thor.

She was captured by the Asha'man at the Battle of Dumai's Wells.

Chisaine Nurbaya, Janine Pavlara, Innina Darenhold and Vayelle Kamsa are the last four of the prisoners to swear fealty to Rand. They did so under Verin's Compulsion.

As with many Aes Sedai sworn to Rand, Innina probably fought the Last Battle on the slopes of Thakan'dar. It is not stated whether she survived or not.
